cases.question: How has gross margin moved over the last 8 quarters?
cases.note: The demo question. Must cite every figure.
cases.report_md:
The gross margin was 0.7515 (75.15 %) in the quarter ending 2024‑07‑28 [[fact:17]].  
It fell sharply to 0.6052 (60.52 %) in the quarter ending 2025‑04‑27 [[fact:20]], then recovered to 0.7242 (72.42 %) by the quarter ending 2025‑07‑27 [[fact:21]] and rose further to 0.7341 (73.41 %) in the quarter ending 2025‑10‑26 [[fact:22]].  
The margin continued its upward trend, reaching 0.7500 (75.00 %) by the quarter ending 2026‑01‑25 [[fact:23]] and holding at 0.7493 (74.93 %) in the quarter ending 2026‑04‑26 [[fact:24]].  
After the early‑2025 dip, gross margins returned to the mid‑70 % range in subsequent quarters (72–75 %), as shown by the values for 2025‑07‑27, 2025‑10‑26, 2026‑01‑25 and 2026‑04‑26 [[fact:21]][[fact:22]][[fact:23]][[fact:24]].
